messages:
noah: Dropped a Canvas prototype for the metrics panel 1 banded area (p10-p90) + point overlay for extremes. Mock: https://redwood.design/protos/banded-canvas rita: Nice perf win. two asks: 1) unit control in the legend that affects axis & tooltips, 2) explicit clipping indicator when we crop tails sam: Smoothing note: the automatic KDE is smoothing away short p99 spikes. can we add presets: off | light | auto? prefer light as default. auto should respect recent spike density anya: A11y: canvas loses native semantics. we need an SVG fallback or an ARIA summary. also contrast between band fill and point color is low for protanopia noah: Implementation plan: keep canvas for perf, render an invisible SVG overlay for interactions/a11y; add a units dropdown labeled "Units (axis & tooltips)"; clip band to 99.5% and draw clipped points as outlined circles with bigger hit targets rita: If clipped, annotate axis: "Latency (ms) clipped to 99.5%". tooltip should show "displayed value (original X)" when hovering a clipped point sam: Hover details: show raw timestamp, original un-clipped value and a quick "Open traces" link. Also when switching to seconds, force tick formatting to 2 decimals for subsecond values anya: ARIA suggestion: aria-label = "Latency band for /infer: median 36 ms; p95 118 ms; clipped values shown as dots" and aria-describedby pointing at the clipping info button. keyboard focus should land on points and announce "outlier, 1.2s, open traces" design-bot: Checklist attached to D-3001: units dropdown, canvas+svg fallback, smoothing presets, clipping badge + tooltip behavior, SR aria label + aria-describedby, Storybook fixtures, axe run in CI noah: Example snippet I'll drop in the PR: ```html
``` I'll also include .point:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); } and ensure tab order is logical rita: Copy nit: legend helper should read "Units used by axis and tooltips" (clearer). clipping badge copy: "clipped to 99.5%" (no pct abbrev) sam: :thumbsup: I'll add Storybook stories for off/light/auto smoothing, a clipped-data example, and a screen-reader story. also adding an integration test that toggles units + smoothing and asserts the axis label updates
